articles.title: A Sweet Surprise in Deep Space: Raspberry Sugar Hints at Life's Cosmic Origins
articles.summary: Astronomers have detected erythrulose — a sugar found in raspberries — inside a molecular cloud near the Milky Way's center. It's the first true sugar ever found in the interstellar medium, and it could transform into the building blocks of DNA and RNA.

articles.title: Gentle Giants of the Gulf: Whale Sharks Filmed Off Florida's Coast
articles.summary: Using a baited underwater camera, researchers with Florida's Fish and Wildlife Conservation Commission recorded whale sharks near the Dry Tortugas. These endangered filter-feeders can reach 60 feet and play a crucial role in marine ecosystems.

articles.title: Homer's Iliad Found Inside a 1,600-Year-Old Egyptian Mummy — a First in Archaeology
articles.summary: At the Oxyrhynchus site in Egypt, a papyrus fragment from Book II of the Iliad was discovered deliberately placed on a Roman-era mummy's abdomen. It's the first known case of a Greek literary text used in mummification.
